$comment: drain.group (card xym8nt4): post-approval card grouping. enabled (boolean, standard false; env WE_DRAIN_GROUP_ENABLED true/false, 1/0, on/off): approved, red-team-clear, card-only PRs (every changed path a backlog card) that the queue file-overlap guard defers and that share a card file are combined by the drain into ONE PR on current main (git merge-tree; conflicts only via the Also-raised-by union resolver; the combined lines must equal the union of the source lines). The combined PR is reviewed again and passes every gate; the source PRs stay open, are held, and are closed only after the combined PR merges and their lines are confirmed on main. Any failure dissolves the group and the sources land on their own. maxSize (2..20, standard 8; env WE_DRAIN_GROUP_MAX_SIZE), eligibility (only 'card-only'), reconcileSec (15..3600, standard 120), retryMin (1..1440, standard 30). Code PRs are never grouped. See we:scripts/lib/card-group.mjs.
